stories.title: Israeli army says seized two suspects in south Syria

en.summary: The Israeli military reported apprehending two individuals on a motorcycle who were approaching an army outpost in an occupied area of southern Syria. No Israeli soldiers were injured during the operation.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia to begin residency program for undocumented Yemenis

en.title: Saudi Arabia to begin residency program for undocumented Yemenis
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Interior Ministry announced it will begin regularizing the legal status of Yemeni nationals residing in the Kingdom without proper documentation, following a directive from King Salman.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye agreed to immediately implement their collective defense commitments under the Makkah Defense Alliance, including swift deployment of forces and military capabilities to address regional security threats.

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns continued Houthi attacks, reaffirms right to defend itself
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned ongoing Iran-backed Houthi attacks on civilian targets, infrastructure, and vessels in the Red Sea, while reaffirming the Kingdom's right to self-defense.

en.summary: The Saudi-led Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen launched Operation Dawn of Yemen with 100 fighter jets destroying 324 high-value targets while providing air support to Yemeni government forces against Houthi-held territory.

stories.title: ‎What SICO Bank expects for Q3 2026 earnings

en.title: What SICO Bank expects for Q3 2026 earnings
en.summary: SICO Bank released Q3 2026 earnings forecasts for Tadawul-listed banks and firms. Al Rajhi Bank is projected to achieve SAR 6.95 billion in net profit, representing a 9% year-on-year increase, with various other financial institutions and companies showing mixed growth expectations.

en.title: Al Yamamah Steel signs two steel tower contracts worth SAR 254.3M
en.summary: Al Yamamah Steel Industries signed two contracts with Algihaz Contracting for SAR 254.28 million to supply steel towers for a 380 kV transmission line project in the Western Region, with deliveries beginning in March 2027.

stories.title: ‎ADES shareholders to vote on 100% capital increase on Oct. 28

en.title: ADES shareholders to vote on 100% capital increase on Oct. 28
en.summary: ADES Holding will hold a shareholder vote on October 28 to approve doubling its capital to SAR 2.26 billion through a bonus share issuance, with one new share granted for each existing share.
